name: Clouded Writings
source:
You wake up to a sight of a cloudscape, when a mysterious figure approaches you. Entertain it by writing a short story with it! 

[from [url=https://nitunio.itch.io/clouded-writings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一覺醒來，眼前是一片雲海，一個神秘的身影向你走來。和它一起寫篇小故事，逗它開心吧！

［摘自[url=https://nitunio.itch.io/clouded-writings]itch.io[/url]］
